_comment: Human-verified verdicts and FOSS alternatives (research 2026-10-11). Keys are fnmatch globs on the item name, first match wins. 'candidates' are package/program names checked live to fill Alternative.installed.

jdk*-openjdk: OpenJDK: GPL-2.0 with Classpath exception; 'LicenseRef-Java' is only Arch's label
jdk-openjdk: OpenJDK: GPL-2.0 with Classpath exception; 'LicenseRef-Java' is only Arch's label
mingw-w64-crt: COPYING.MinGW-w64*: ZPL-2.1 overall, BSD/MIT/public-domain parts; Arch labels it LicenseRef-custom
mingw-w64-headers: COPYING.MinGW-w64*: ZPL-2.1 overall, BSD/MIT/public-domain parts; Arch labels it LicenseRef-custom
mingw-w64-winpthreads: COPYING.MinGW-w64*: ZPL-2.1 overall, BSD/MIT/public-domain parts; Arch labels it LicenseRef-custom
gamescope: BSD-2-Clause; bundled ReShade effect compiler is BSD-3-Clause
lib32-gamescope*: BSD-2-Clause; bundled ReShade effect compiler is BSD-3-Clause
7zip: LGPL/BSD, but the RAR decoder carries the unRAR restriction
endless-sky: GPL-3.0 code; a few landscape images use the non-free Unsplash License
osu-lazer*: Code MIT; osu-resources (skins, samples, fonts) CC-BY-NC-4.0
libfdk-aac: FSF: free 'as far as it goes', GPL-incompatible; Debian non-free
intel-oneapi-umf: oneAPI Unified Memory Framework is open source
xone-dongle-firmware: firmware blob: Xbox wireless dongle firmware extracted from Microsoft's driver
lib32-nvidia-utils: firmware blob: NVIDIA proprietary userspace driver (32-bit)
wd719x-firmware: firmware blob: Western Digital SCSI firmware
dufs: sigoden/dufs release binary; Cargo.toml: MIT OR Apache-2.0
nvidia-cg-toolkit: NVIDIA Cg licence: binary-only, no modification
ceserver: Cheat Engine: source-available, upstream has no LICENSE (no grant)
crafty: Hyatt notice: personal use only without written permission
musictube: Flavio Tordini, proprietary paid app ('All Rights Reserved')
krita-plugin-pythonplugindevelopertools-: no license (all rights reserved): upstream repo has no LICENSE file
0ad-data*: GPL-2.0+ data, CC-BY-SA-3.0 art/audio; the AUR NC label is wrong
marker-pdf: Code open; model weights under modified OpenRAIL-M (revenue-capped)
Proton*: BSD-3 glue + Wine/DXVK/vkd3d (free); shipped through Steam
Steam Linux Runtime*: Mostly Debian FOSS libraries, distributed under the Steam Subscriber Agreement
photopea-mcp-server: MIT, but it drives the proprietary Photopea web app
miniconda3: conda BSD-3; note Anaconda 'defaults' channel ToS
YouTube Music: Pear Desktop (ex th-ch/youtube-music), MIT; client of a proprietary service
dnssec-anchors: Public domain data (manually verified custom license)
iana-etc: Public domain data (manually verified custom license)
licenses: Arch license texts (manually verified custom license)
gsm: TU Berlin permissive (manually verified custom license)
libldap: OpenLDAP Public License (manually verified custom license)
vscodium-insiders-marketplace: VSCodium patch package (MIT) (manually verified custom license)
_libgcc_mutex *: conda meta-package, no code (manually verified custom license)
depotdownloader: SteamRE DepotDownloader, GPL-2.0 (manually verified custom license)
osu!*: Code MIT; osu-resources (skins, samples, fonts) CC-BY-NC-4.0
Cloudflare Zero Trust CLI: Cloudflare WARP client (warp-cli): proprietary, Cloudflare terms of service
mongo: SSPL-1.0: source-available, rejected by the OSI; the image has no license label
confluentinc/cp-*: Confluent's image reference lists the confluent-kafka package (cp-kafka) under Apache 2.0, not the Confluent Community License; cp-zookeeper installs the same package (not verified separately); no license label
gitlab/gitlab-ce: GitLab Community Edition is MIT (gitlab-foss); the omnibus image also bundles other free components; no license label
joplin/server: Joplin Server is under the Joplin Server Personal Use License (packages/server/LICENSE.md, v.1 2021), not AGPL like the Joplin apps
ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui: Open WebUI License: BSD-3-Clause plus a clause forbidding removal of the Open WebUI branding beyond 50 users per 30 days; not OSI-approved (label says NOASSERTION)
bbernhard/signal-cli-rest-api: REST wrapper is MIT (repository license); it bundles signal-cli, GPL-3.0 (from memory, not verified); no license label
provectuslabs/kafka-ui: Apache-2.0 per the repository license; no license label
koalaman/shellcheck: ShellCheck is GPL-3.0 per the repository license; no license label
barichello/godot-ci: Image recipe is MIT (abarichello/godot-ci LICENSE); bundles Godot (MIT) and its export templates; no license label
valkey/valkey: BSD-3-Clause per the repository license; no license label
roundcube/roundcubemail: GPL-3.0 per the repository license; no license label
codeberg.org/endurain-project/endurain: AGPL-3.0 (LICENSE file on Codeberg); no license label
GitKrakenCLI: GitKraken CLI (gk): closed-source proprietary binary under the GitKraken EULA
Blender Launcher: Blender Launcher V2, GPL-3.0 upstream (Victor-IX/Blender-Launcher-V2); the PyInstaller bundle ships no license file
Tachidesk: Suwayomi Tachidesk-Server, MPL-2.0; bundled KCEF is Apache-2.0 and wraps CEF/Chromium (BSD-3-Clause)
gh-copilot: GitHub Copilot CLI: closed-source binary, no license grant (all rights reserved); service under GitHub's Copilot terms
android-sdk: Android SDK License (proprietary Google terms, accepted via licenses/android-sdk-license)
GE-Proton*: BSD-3-Clause Proton glue + Wine (LGPL), DXVK (zlib), vkd3d-proton (LGPL); bundled fonts OFL-1.1, AV1 patent grant (PATENTS.AV1)
godot export templates: MIT: Godot Engine export templates, built from the engine source; the folder ships no license file
github actions-runner: MIT: actions/runner (upstream LICENSE); the installed runner folder ships no license file

claude-code.effortReason: Harness is replaceable; porting hooks/skills/MCP setup is the work
claude-code.lockIn: The model itself is not replaceable; local Qwen3-Coder is clearly weaker

claude.effortReason: Harness is replaceable; porting hooks/skills/MCP setup is the work
claude.lockIn: The model itself is not replaceable

google-chrome.lockIn: Chrome adds only branding, codecs, Widevine and Google Sync

discord.effortReason: Same account and servers; only the client changes
discord.lockIn: FOSS shell around Discord's proprietary service (Vesktop/Dorion load Discord's own web JS); third-party clients break Discord ToS

steam*.effortReason: Store, DRM and library are Valve's service
steam*.lockIn: Steam-DRM games only run through Steam

nvidia-utils.lockIn: NVK ~40-70% of proprietary perf, no RT/DLSS (2026)

opencl-nvidia.lockIn: Needs NVK for GPU; PoCL is CPU

cuda.effortReason: CUDA ecosystem; PyTorch/ollama need it on NVIDIA

nsight-*.effortReason: Kernel-level GPU profiling needs vendor counters

nvidia-cg-toolkit.effortReason: Only punes-git needs it; port its shaders or drop the dep

intel-oneapi-*.effortReason: Pulled in by blender and python-tensorflow; intel-oneapi-mkl is an orphan
intel-oneapi-*.lockIn: Only prebuilt binaries need the closed runtimes

*unrar*.lockIn: RAR creation is proprietary-only; extraction is covered. libunrar is pulled by calibre

nmap.effortReason: Port+service scanner is M; NSE scripts and OS-fingerprint DB are L
nmap.lockIn: NPSL is source-available; fine for personal use

aseprite*.effortReason: Rebuilding the aseprite MCP/Lua tooling for Pixelorama
aseprite*.lockIn: Source-available: you may build it yourself for personal use

geoip-database.effortReason: Country-level DB from RIR data; only python-geoip needs it

flashplayer-standalone*.lockIn: Some heavy AS3/Stage3D content still fails in Ruffle

CPLEX*.lockIn: CPLEX still wins on large hard MIPs

unity.effortReason: Per-project port; Asset Store assets do not carry over

memstack-skill-loader.effortReason: A skill loader is a small script

osu-lazer*.effortReason: Skinning work for a full CC0 resource set

libfdk-aac.lockIn: Pulled in by gst-plugins-bad and pipewire-audio

names: FerretDB (Apache-2.0, MongoDB wire protocol on PostgreSQL)
mongo.effortReason: FerretDB speaks the Mongo protocol, but unsupported commands and the dump/restore need testing per app
mongo.lockIn: Data must be exported and re-imported; the Mongo aggregation pipeline is only partly emulated

names: Nextcloud (AGPL-3.0) or any WebDAV server as the Joplin sync target
joplin/server.effortReason: The Joplin apps sync to WebDAV/Nextcloud natively; switch the sync target and re-sync
joplin/server.lockIn: Joplin Server-only features (sharing, publishing notes) are lost; notes stay portable

names: Ollama's own CLI/API with a FOSS front end
ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui.effortReason: Same OpenAI/Ollama back ends; chats and settings do not migrate
ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui.lockIn: Stored chat history and RAG collections stay in Open WebUI's database

GitKrakenCLI.effortReason: Terminal Git UIs cover commits, branches and diffs; gk workspaces and Launchpad have no equivalent
GitKrakenCLI.lockIn: Cloud workspaces and Launchpad data live in GitKraken's service

gh-copilot.effortReason: The CLI is a thin client for command suggest/explain; any LLM CLI does the same
gh-copilot.lockIn: Copilot model access is the lock-in, not the binary

names: foss-android-sdk: scripts/foss_android_sdk.sh + foss_android_ndk.sh (fit good, effort M; Robolectric android-all platforms 34-37 + OpenJDK java.*, lzhiyong build-tools behind an aapt2 arg wrapper, Arch cmake/adb, NDK = Arch clang + AOSP bionic sysroot + LLVM libc++/compiler-rt for arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86_64, x86 (no riscv64); apksigner built from AOSP apksig; android-all has hidden APIs; verified: todo release APK on a Pixel 6a)
lzhiyong/android-sdk-tools: AOSP-built aapt2/aapt/zipalign/aidl/dexdump (Apache-2.0; fit partial, effort L; via android.aapt2FromMavenOverride, latest 35.0.2 lags; platforms/NDK still Google's)
AOSP source build, m sdk sdk_repo (Apache-2.0; fit good, effort XL; ~400 GB checkout and hours per release)
Debian android-sdk-meta rebuilds (Apache-2.0; fit none, effort L; frozen at platform 23 / build-tools 29, Flutter needs compileSdk 35+)
android-sdk.effortReason: The scripts assemble platforms, build-tools and an NDK from free sources in minutes; armv7/x86_64 NDK targets and each new API level are still manual
android-sdk.lockIn: Play Store targetSdk rules track Google's SDK releases; F-Droid's AGPL sdkmanager only fetches the same Google binaries
